other_conditions: At least 50% of family income must come from weaving activities.
Lighting unit must be purchased from a GST‑registered dealer with a valid TIN.
Only one member per family can benefit from the scheme.
benefits_summary: Free 20‑watt tube lights and 35‑watt fans, inverter purchase assistance up to ₹17,500 in two installments, and interest‑free loans up to ₹5,000.
